items.html: It is found that the sin of the first man and the sin of the destruction of the Second Temple are all one, except that the sin of the first man actually corrected the Klipot, which at first were without correction, as said, with the help of God. But at the time of the destruction, through the sin of Israel, the Klipot were already corrected, and what they caused was to return and clothe the holiness in them, as above.
